en.s: The earthquake that struck Aleppo and the rest of northern Syria on 11 October 1138 was among the deadliest earthquakes in history. The earthquake, preceded by a smaller one on 10 October, caused damage and chaos to many places in the area around Aleppo. It is frequently listed as the third deadliest earthquake in history, following on from the Shensi and Tangshan earthquakes in China.

zh.s: 1138年10月11日，阿勒颇及叙利亚北部其他地区发生地震，是历史上伤亡最惨重的地震之一。此前一天（10月10日）发生过一次较小的地震，此次地震则使阿勒颇周边多地受损并陷入混乱。它常被列为历史上伤亡第三惨重的地震，仅次于中国的陕西地震和唐山大地震。

en.s: The Treaty of Shaoxing (Chinese: 绍兴和议; pinyin: Shàoxīng Héyì) was the agreement and truce that ended the protracted military conflicts between the Jin dynasty and the Southern Song dynasty. It also legally drew up the boundaries of the two countries and forced the Song dynasty to renounce all claims to its former (Northern Song) territories north of the Qinling Huaihe Line, which included its former capital of Kaifeng. Emperor Gaozong of Song subsequently executed the anti-Jin faction general Yue Fei after the treaty. The treaty was signed in 1141, and under it the Southern Song agreed to paying tribute of 250,000 taels and 250,000 packs of silk to the suzerain Jin every year (until 1164, when Jin launched a further war against the Southern Song). The treaty was formally ratified on 11 October 1142 when a Jin envoy visited the Song court.

zh.s: 《绍兴和议》是金朝与南宋之间结束长期军事冲突的一项协议和停战协定，也划定了两国边界，迫使宋朝放弃对秦岭—淮河线以北原北宋领土的所有主张，其中包括旧都开封。条约签订后，宋高宗处死了反金派将领岳飞。双方于1141年签订条约；根据条约，南宋每年向宗主国金朝进贡25万两白银和25万匹绢，直到1164年金朝再次对南宋开战。1142年10月11日，金朝使节访问宋廷，条约正式获批。

en.s: The Battle of Maclodio was fought on 11 October 1427, resulting in a victory for the Venetians under Carmagnola over the Milanese under Carlo I Malatesta. The battle was fought at Maclodio (or Macalo) a small town near the River Oglio, fifteen kilometres (nine miles) south-west of Brescia. This battle, fought during the second campaign, was the only decisive victory for Venice in the Wars in Lombardy. This battle forced the Milanese into a treaty, conceding Brescia in 1428, though fighting of the wars in Lombardy was to resume later, continuing until the Treaty of Lodi in 1454.

zh.s: 马克洛迪奥之战于1427年10月11日爆发，卡尔马尼奥拉率领的威尼斯军队击败卡洛一世·马拉泰斯塔率领的米兰军队。战斗发生在马克洛迪奥（又称马卡洛），这是一座靠近奥廖河的小镇，位于布雷西亚西南15公里（9英里）处。此战发生于第二次战役期间，是威尼斯在伦巴第战争中唯一一次决定性胜利。战败后，米兰被迫签订条约，于1428年让出布雷西亚；不过伦巴第战争后来再度爆发，一直持续到1454年《洛迪和约》签署。

en.s: The Battle of Bosco Marengo (aka Battle of Frascata) was fought in the autumn of 1447. The Duke of Orleans, Charles I, son of Valentina Visconti, laid claim to the Duchy of Milan and dispatched an army from the Dauphiné and Lyonais under Renaud du Dresnay into Lombardy. The Golden Ambrosian Republic responded and dispatched a total of 3,700 troops under Colleoni to Alessandria.

zh.s: 博斯科马伦戈之战（又称弗拉斯卡塔之战）发生于1447年秋。奥尔良公爵查理一世是瓦伦蒂娜·维斯孔蒂之子，他宣称拥有米兰公国继承权，并从多菲内和里昂地区派遣雷诺·迪·德雷斯奈率军进入伦巴第。金色安布罗西亚共和国随即应战，派遣科莱奥尼率领共3,700名士兵前往亚历山德里亚。

en.t: The Burchardi flood kills around 15,000 in North Friesland, Denmark and Germany
en.s: The Burchardi flood (also known as the second Grote Mandrenke) was a storm tide that struck the North Sea coast of North Frisia, Dithmarschen (in modern-day Germany) and southwest Jutland (in modern-day Denmark) on the night between 11 and 12 October 1634. Overrunning dikes, it shattered the coastline and caused thousands of deaths (8,000 to 15,000 people drowned) and catastrophic material damage.

zh.t: 布尔哈迪洪水在北弗里西亚造成约15,000人死亡
zh.s: 布尔哈迪洪水又称第二次“大洪灾”，是1634年10月11日至12日夜间袭击北海沿岸的一场风暴潮，波及北弗里西亚、迪特马尔申（今属德国）和日德兰西南部（今属丹麦）。海水冲垮堤坝，摧毁海岸线，造成数千人死亡（8,000至15,000人溺亡）以及灾难性的财产损失。

en.s: The fourth siege of Breda (21 July – 11 October 1637) was an important siege in the Eighty Years' War in which stadtholder Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange retook the city of Breda, which had last changed hands in 1625 when the Spanish general Ambrogio Spinola conquered it for the Spanish Habsburgs. Hereafter, the city would remain in the hands of the Dutch Republic until the end of the war.

en.s: The Sack of Wexford took place from 2 to 11 October 1649, during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland, part of the 1641–1653 Irish Confederate Wars. English Commonwealth forces under Oliver Cromwell stormed the town after negotiations broke down, killing most of the Irish Confederate and Royalist garrison. Many civilians also died, either during the sack, or drowned attempting to escape across the River Slaney.

en.s: The Battle of Shakar Kheda took place on 11 October 1724 at Shakar Kheda (Shakar Khela or Sankar Kedla) in Berar, 80 miles from Aurangabad between Nizam-ul-Mulk and Mubariz Khan, Subedar of the Deccan. Mubariz Khan marched from Hyderabad against the Nizam-ul-Mulk who was ready to meet the challenge. Both fought for some time and at last at Shakar Kheda. In this decisive battle against great odds, Nizam ul-Mulk defeated and killed Mubariz Khan. After the victory of Nizam, officers and soldiers who took part in the battle were rewarded with cash and titles.

zh.s: 沙卡尔赫达之战于1724年10月11日在贝拉尔的沙卡尔赫达（又称沙卡尔赫拉或桑卡尔凯德拉）爆发，地点距奥朗加巴德80英里。交战双方是尼扎姆·乌尔·穆尔克和德干苏巴达尔穆巴里兹汗。穆巴里兹汗从海得拉巴出兵迎战，尼扎姆·乌尔·穆尔克也准备应战。双方交战一段时间后，最终在沙卡尔赫达决战。尼扎姆兵力处于劣势，但在这场决定性战斗中击败并杀死穆巴里兹汗。胜利后，参战的军官和士兵获得现金和头衔作为奖赏。

en.s: The Battle of Valcour Island, also known as the Battle of Valcour Bay, was a naval engagement that took place on October 11, 1776, on Lake Champlain. The main action took place in Valcour Bay, a narrow strait between the New York mainland and Valcour Island. The battle is generally regarded as one of the first naval battles of the American Revolutionary War, and one of the first fought by the Continental Navy.

zh.s: 瓦尔库尔岛之战又称瓦尔库尔湾之战，于1776年10月11日在尚普兰湖爆发，是一场海战。主要战斗发生在瓦尔库尔湾，这是纽约大陆与瓦尔库尔岛之间的一段狭窄水道。此战通常被认为是美国独立战争期间最早的海战之一，也是大陆海军最早参与的海战之一。

en.s: The Second Battle of Châtillon (11 October 1793) was fought between Royalist and Republican French forces at Châtillon-sur-Sèvre during the War in the Vendée. A 20,000-man Republican column commanded by Alexis Chalbos from the Army of the Coasts of La Rochelle was attacked and routed by Vendean Royalist forces led by Louis Marie de Lescure and Charles de Bonchamps. That night a few hundred Republicans under François Joseph Westermann raided the rebel encampment. Before the Vendeans killed or drove them off, the raiders inflicted severe losses on drunken rebel fighters and non-combatant women and children. The Vendeans withdrew toward Mortagne-sur-Sèvre the next day.

zh.s: 第二次沙蒂永之战于1793年10月11日爆发，是旺代战争期间保王派法国军队与共和派法国军队在塞夫尔河畔沙蒂永进行的一场战斗。亚历克西·沙尔博指挥的共和军罗谢尔沿岸军团有2万人，遭到路易·玛丽·德·莱斯屈尔和夏尔·德·邦尚率领的旺代保王军袭击并击溃。当晚，弗朗索瓦·约瑟夫·韦斯特曼率领数百名共和军袭击叛军营地。袭击者在被旺代军杀死或赶走之前，给喝醉的叛军战士以及妇女和儿童等非战斗人员造成重大伤亡。次日，旺代军向莫尔塔涅-叙尔-塞夫尔撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Camperdown (known in Dutch as the Zeeslag bij Kamperduin) was a major naval action fought on 11 October 1797, between a Royal Navy fleet under Admiral Adam Duncan and a Dutch Navy fleet under Vice-Admiral Jan de Winter. The battle was the most significant action between British and Dutch forces during the French Revolutionary Wars and resulted in a complete victory for the British, who captured eleven Dutch ships without losing any of their own. In 1795, the Dutch Republic had been overrun by the army of the French Republic and had been reorganised into the Batavian Republic, a French client state.

zh.s: 坎珀当海战（荷兰语：Zeeslag bij Kamperduin）于1797年10月11日爆发，交战双方是亚当·邓肯海军上将率领的英国皇家海军舰队与扬·德·温特中将率领的荷兰海军舰队。此战是法国大革命战争期间英荷之间最重要的一次交锋，英国取得全面胜利，俘获11艘荷兰船只，己方无一损失。1795年，法国共和国军队占领荷兰共和国，并将其改组为法国的附庸国巴达维亚共和国。

en.s: The Myyrmanni bombing took place on October 11, 2002, in Myyrmäki, Vantaa, Finland, in Greater Helsinki, at the Myyrmanni shopping mall. A bomb exploded at 19:36 killing five immediately, including the bomber. In total seven died, including two teenagers and a 7-year-old. 166 people were injured, including 10 children. 66 victims required hospitalization with the remainder treated and released at the scene. The shopping center was especially crowded, with 1,000–2,000 people, including many children who had come to see a clown performance. The perpetrator was Petri Erkki Tapio Gerdt (April 17, 1983 - October 11, 2002), who was killed in the explosion.

zh.s: 2002年10月11日，芬兰万塔米尔迈基的米尔马尼购物中心发生爆炸，地点位于大赫尔辛基地区。19时36分炸弹爆炸，当场造成5人死亡，其中包括爆炸者。最终共有7人死亡，包括两名青少年和一名7岁儿童；166人受伤，其中包括10名儿童。66名伤者需要住院治疗，其余人在现场接受处理后离开。购物中心当时特别拥挤，有1,000至2,000人，其中许多儿童是来观看小丑表演的。作案者是彼得里·埃尔基·塔皮奥·格尔特（1983年4月17日至2002年10月11日），他在爆炸中死亡。
